definitions.explanation: The act of officially revealing or making information available that was previously private or restricted. Commonly used in legal, financial, and corporate contexts.

examples.japanese: ⟦{情報|じょうほう}→情報：03348_jouhou⟧{開示|かいじ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{求|もと}める→求める：02316_motomeru⟧。
⟦{企業|きぎょう}→企業：00225_kigyou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{財務|ざいむ}→財務：05971_zaimu⟧⟦{情報|じょうほう}→情報：03348_jouhou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{開示|かいじ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{義務|ぎむ}→義務：02647_gimu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Companies have an obligation to disclose financial information.

examples.japanese: ⟦{個人|こじん}{情報|じょうほう}→個人情報：18842_kojinjouhou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{開示|かいじ}⟦{請求|せいきゅう}→請求：03374_seikyuu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{行|おこな}った→行う：01238_okonau⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{一部|いちぶ}→一部：06783_ichibu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{非公開|ひこうかい}→非公開：16599_hikoukai⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I filed a request for disclosure of personal information, but part of it was kept confidential.

notes:
A ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ verb used in formal, legal, and business contexts. Particularly common in discussions about corporate governance, freedom of information, and data privacy.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{情報|じょうほう}→情報：03348_jouhou⟧{開示|かいじ} (information disclosure)
- {開示|かいじ}⟦{請求|せいきゅう}→請求：03374_seikyuu⟧ (disclosure request)
- {開示|かいじ}⟦{義務|ぎむ}→義務：02647_gimu⟧ (disclosure obligation)
- {開示|かいじ}⟦{資料|しりょう}→資料：04166_shiryou⟧ (disclosed documents)

In financial contexts, {適時|てきじ}{開示|かいじ} (timely disclosure) refers to the obligation of listed companies to promptly disclose material information to investors.
